subject.title: [Workspace panel] Root path drops leading dot, false 'Missing' labels on existing folders, broken layout

question: Should session workspace listings expose existence, size, or mtime for transcript-mentioned paths outside or rejected by the fs-safe workspace root, or must the false-Missing fix preserve neutral/hidden external metadata semantics?
rationale: The linked fix attempt changes a gateway file metadata boundary, and automation should not choose the permanent security semantics for outside-root transcript paths.

options.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
options.body: Fix false Missing by filtering, neutral display, or in-root directory semantics while keeping external or fs-safe-rejected paths from exposing raw filesystem metadata.

options.title: Expose External Metadata Deliberately
options.body: Allow `sessions.files.list` to report existence metadata for transcript-mentioned external paths, with explicit tests and maintainer-owned security rationale.

options.title: Split Layout From Backend Semantics
options.body: Land only any remaining workspace-rail CSS proof separately while pausing backend Missing-badge semantics for a narrower design decision.

recommendation.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
recommendation.body: Fix false Missing by filtering, neutral display, or in-root directory semantics while keeping external or fs-safe-rejected paths from exposing raw filesystem metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workspace browsing and fs-safe boundary work makes this the strongest available owner for the gateway file metadata decision.
